items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the mention of Lucky Miller is made by the interviewer in a narrative about Henry 'Red' Allen.

ctx.x: ... He never would let nobody play. Red Allen could play ... he and Lucky Miller (?), Attlee. Of course, you never heard no trombone player play jazz. You hear trumpets now But you never heard no trombones.

Yeah, well, that's why we were talking about the Luis Russell period because like I know he recorded a lot of songs and I didn't know some of the songs were your songs. I know there was a period when you came with the band, with Luis Russell's band or with Louis Armstrong's band, you were with Luis Russell's band and then Louis Armstrong came in front of the band.
